candidate.mark_source: CoinGecko ZEC/USD live volume-weighted spot across 49 exchanges / 83 markets

threshold_reason: The Sep. 15 starter was based on exchange-withdrawal accumulation plus persistent shielded-pool usage, but lacked a fresh independent product confirmation.

The completed NU7 coinholder vote supplied that independent product/governance leg: nearly 2.4M eligible ZEC participated; 99.9% supported reducing block targets from 75s to 25s, 98.9% supported preserving halvings, 96.6% supported delaying NSM fee reissuance until February 2031, and 99.3% supported shipping NU7 quickly rather than waiting for unfinished scope.

The initial post-vote move was not chased. Earlier on Sep. 16 ZEC had retraced near $1,127 after an initial spike; by this run it had recovered to $1,204.97 near the top of its $1,088.87-$1,212.19 24h range, while 24h spot turnover rose to about $1.305B, +39% day/day. This converts the earlier failed first reaction into a second price/volume confirmation leg.
Privacy use remains financially substantive rather than incentive-driven: 4,895,790 ZEC, 28.9% of issued supply, remained inside shielded pools in the latest ZecStats snapshot.

capital_migration_classification.why_capital_appears_substantive: ZEC is being accumulated as the native asset and moved into native privacy pools. The qualifying evidence is exchange withdrawal accumulation, shielded-balance stock, governance participation and broad spot turnover; no points, quests, trading-reward, rebate or liquidity-mining program is used as the trigger.
what_is_not_counted: Raw influencer endorsements are not counted as confirmation.
Governance participation is not treated as equivalent to new-money inflow; it is product/governance conviction from eligible balances.
The NU7 vote is advisory and is not treated as completed protocol implementation.

product_governance_evidence.implementation_status: NOT_YET_IMPLEMENTED; requires specification, implementation, testing and activation
product_governance_evidence.interpretation: High-participation governance meaningfully reduces uncertainty about the direction of the next protocol upgrade without increasing daily issuance merely because blocks become more frequent.

privacy_usage.interpretation: Shielded balance is a harder-to-game stock metric than note counts or transaction counts because ZEC must actually cross into a shielded value pool. It does not reveal beneficial-owner diversity or shielded-to-shielded velocity.

market_persistence.interpretation: The token has recovered from the earlier same-day rejection and is trading near its 24h high with materially higher spot turnover. This is scored as confirmation after a failed first reaction, not as a first-minute buyer-count signal.

wallet_quality.supporting_history: The Sep. 15 starter recorded two distinct exchange-withdrawal paths totaling roughly 49.23K ZEC, but beneficial-owner independence and historical selectivity were not proven.
wallet_quality.independence_check: No new funding-lineage evidence in this run was sufficient to promote the wallet-quality score.
wallet_quality.interpretation: The add is justified by an independent product/governance plus market-persistence leg, not by pretending the old accumulation paths are fresh smart-money confirmation.

social_news_attention.evidence: NU7 results received fresh independent press coverage on Sep. 16. Older high-profile endorsements from Arthur Hayes, Matt Hougan and others are explicitly discounted and not used as a positive score because concentrated influencer promotion can be reflexive or late-cycle attention.

liquidity_executability.evidence: CoinGecko showed about $1.305B of 24h ZEC turnover across 49 exchanges / 83 markets. Major venue order books showed multi-million-dollar two-sided depth within 2% (including Binance and Coinbase), making a roughly $242 paper add negligible relative to executable liquidity.

structural_gate.sellability_honeypot: PASS; ZEC is a native PoW asset with deep multi-venue markets rather than a creator-controlled smart-contract token.
structural_gate.mint_freeze_permissions: NOT_APPLICABLE in the ERC/SPL sense; issuance is consensus-defined.
structural_gate.lp_control: No single creator-controlled LP is required for exit liquidity.
structural_gate.supply_concentration: Beneficial ownership is intrinsically harder to audit because shielded balances conceal ownership; no hard concentration failure can be claimed from transparent-address scans alone.
structural_gate.ongoing_issuance: Current PoW issuance remains a supply headwind until future halvings.
structural_gate.regulatory_listing_risk: Privacy-asset regulatory and exchange-listing risk remains material.
structural_gate.wash_bot_creator_dump: No new evidence in this run triggered a hard rejection for creator dumping, wash trading, bot domination or suspicious token transfers.

paper_trade.sizing_reason: 2.5% of pre-trade NAV confirmation add. Total ZEC remains well below the 7.5% non-core ceiling because no fresh selective-wallet cohort was verified and NU7 remains unimplemented.

existing_positions_action.SOL: HOLD_NO_ADD; Solana tokenized-equity secondary trading remains strong but chain stablecoin stock is down week/week and RAY token leadership is unconfirmed.
existing_positions_action.SUI: HOLD_NO_ADD; stablecoin supply growth is not converting into DEX/perps acceleration.
existing_positions_action.BNB: HOLD_NO_ADD; BNB Chain spot activity remains active but recent acceleration has faded and net inflows are weak/negative.
existing_positions_action.UNI: HOLD_NO_ADD; Arc launch is a real distribution/product catalyst, but it was pre-announced and no fresh Arc usage or selective-wallet confirmation justifies moving UNI beyond its existing ~5% position.
existing_positions_action.HYPE: HOLD_NO_ADD; protocol economics remain strong but repeated institutional exchange deposits and dilution risk still block scaling.
existing_positions_action.AERO: HOLD_NO_ADD; Base tokenized-equity activity is real but trader/LP incentive contamination and Raydium's competing RWA venue leadership still require a post-incentive persistence test.
existing_positions_action.ZEC: ADD_2.5_PERCENT_NAV; independent NU7 governance/product confirmation plus second-leg price/volume persistence crosses the scaling threshold.

competing_signals_rejected_or_held: Raydium/Solana RWA: xStocks 30-day DEX volume surpassed $1B and Raydium remains the dominant venue, but RAY itself still lacks fresh selective accumulation and has not provided clean token-price persistence; no RAY paper entry.
Base/Aerodrome RWA: actual secondary stock-token use remains substantive, but current cashback and AERO-reward contamination prevents treating all activity as discretionary capital; no AERO add.

Injective: raw DEX/perps percentage acceleration is impressive off a small base, while the main USDC catalyst is a scheduled migration from Noble rather than clearly discretionary new capital; no INJ entry.
Sui: stablecoin growth is positive but DEX and perps volumes are not confirming speculative migration.
Robinhood Chain/PONS: market-quality evidence remains contaminated by purchasable on-chain volume/maker-generation services; raw breadth and turnover are not sufficient for qualification.
Hyperliquid/HYPE: price and protocol economics are resilient, but prior Multicoin/Bitwise exchange-deposit risk remains unresolved; no add or trim.
major_uncertainties: NU7 voting is ZEC-weighted and privacy-preserving, so the number of independent beneficial owners behind the ~2.4M participating ZEC is unknown.
NU7 results are governance direction, not deployed code; implementation and activation may slip or differ.
The two previously observed withdrawal accumulators may share beneficial ownership or institutional purpose.
A large shielded balance proves capital stock inside privacy pools but cannot prove active shielded-to-shielded transaction velocity or unique users.
ZEC remains volatile and sensitive to influencer attention, privacy-regulation headlines and exchange-listing policy.
why_signal_matters_now: This is the first prospective run after the NU7 result in which ZEC repaired its initial same-day price rejection and simultaneously reaccelerated spot turnover while the underlying shielded-capital stock remained high. The independent product/governance catalyst plus the market's second-leg confirmation is sufficiently different from the Sep. 15 wallet-driven starter to justify one additional 2.5%-NAV paper tranche, while the unresolved wallet-independence and implementation risks cap total exposure below 7.5%.
